newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: Lithuanian president names new prime minister.
newsitem.headline: Lithuanian president names new prime minister.

text.p: The president of the Baltic state of Lithuania on Wednesday named a new prime minister for the Baltic state some two weeks after right-wing parties won a landslide victory in parliamentary elections.
President Algirdas Brazauskas named Gediminas Vagnorius as prime minister. He is one of the leaders of the Homeland Union, which ousted a party of ex-Communists in the elections.

The Homeland Union win marked the political comeback of independence hero Vytautas Landsbergis, who spearheaded Lithuania's fight to quit the former Soviet Union in 1991 but was rejected at the ballot box the following year.
"We should seek to form a competent cabinet of ministers which should work for as long as possible," Brazauskas told parliament after he named Vagnorius.
Vagnorius said he would aim to present his new cabinet for parliament approval either on Friday or Monday and present his government programme within 10 days.
Vagnorius, an economist, was prime minister in 1991-92 when Landsbergis was head of state.
